claims.text:
The meaning of the name Ilberic is unknown. J.R.R. Tolkien noted that the names of the Bucklanders had a vaguely Celtic style.
Jim Allan suggests that the name Ilberic seems to be Germanic. It is a variaton of the name Alberic and contains the elements alb ("Elf") and ric ("reign", "rule"). Alberic is a dwarf king in medieval German heroic literature who appears in Richard Wagner's Ring cycle.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix F, "On Translation", p. 1135
